# Scope

For EJAM v2.5.0, "Island Areas" means American Samoa (AS), Guam
(GU), the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands (MP), and the
U.S. Virgin Islands (VI). Puerto Rico is not treated as an Island Area
for this purpose because Puerto Rico is included in both Census 2020 and ACS
data used by EJAM. The U.S. Minor Outlying Islands (UM) are not included in
EJSCREEN/EJAM.

EJAM v2.5.0 includes AS/GU/MP/VI at the blockgroup dataset, EJSCREEN export,
and map-data visibility level. Demographic fields are kept as missing where
ACS data are not available, and partial EPA environmental fields may be present
where EPA provided them.

The annual/release pipeline uses the archived EPA EJScreen 2024 v2.32 ACS2022
reference file as the current source for AS/GU/MP/VI blockgroup row IDs, area
fields, and available environmental fields. The expected Island Area
blockgroup counts are 77 for AS, 58 for GU, 135 for MP, and 416 for VI
(686 total). By default, 2020 Island Areas Census DHC demographic values are
not used in `bg_acsdata` or downstream EJSCREEN-compatible outputs.

EJAM v2.5.0 does not add Island Area Census blocks to the block helper files
used for point-buffer/radius analysis. A report or radius analysis in an Island
Area should not crash, but should normally return no-data results when no
block centroids are available in the area analyzed.

# Census Places

The EJAM `censusplaces` dataset is built from the Census Bureau PLACElist
source. As checked in May 2026, that source did not include city, town, or CDP
rows for AS/GU/MP/VI. As a result, EJAM's city/place picker should not be
expected to offer Island Area places unless the source data and related
selection logic are updated and validated later.

This is a coverage note only. It does not change the way `censusplaces$fips` is
stored or used internally.

# EJSCREEN Map Layers Observed in Island Areas

The following notes summarize a manual check of the live EJSCREEN app in May
2026, covering the 2024, 2025, and 2026 versions. Treat these as observed
layer-availability notes, not as a guarantee that every mapped layer has a
non-null score in every Island Area.

## Maps Tab

| Layer group | Island Area availability observed | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 13 environmental indicators | No | None of the main environmental-indicator map layers appeared available in Island Areas. |
| Climate indicators | Partial | Sea level rise indicators and extreme heat appeared available. Other climate indicators did not. |
| Socioeconomic/key demographic indicators | No | ACS-based demographic indicators were not available. |
| EJ Indexes and Supplementary Indexes | No | EJ Index and Supplementary Index layers were not available. |
| Health disparities | Unclear/limited | Cancer and disabilities appeared to show map colors in at least the U.S. Virgin Islands, but with null scores. |
| Service gaps | Unclear/limited | Housing burden appeared to show map colors in at least the U.S. Virgin Islands, but with null scores. |

## Places Tab

| Layer group | Island Area availability observed | Layers |
|---|---|---|
| EPA regulated facilities | Yes, all checked layers | Superfund, water dischargers, air pollution, hazardous waste, brownfields, Toxics Release Inventory, and Chemical Data Reporting. |
| Other environmental data | Partial | Available: Facilities Compliance Status, Air Toxics Cancer Risk, RSEI Score, and Water Features. Not available: Nonattainment Areas and EJ Grants. Unclear: Private Drinking Water Wells and Drinking Water Service Areas. |
| Community landmarks | Mostly available | Available: schools, hospitals, places of worship, parks, public housing, and subsidized housing. Not available: prisons. |
| Tribal Lands and Indigenous Areas | No | Tribal Lands, Tribal Cession Boundaries, and Other Indigenous Areas were not available. |
| Colonias | No | HUD Colonias Communities, Texas State Colonias, and New Mexico State Colonias were not available. |
| Designated Disadvantaged Communities | Yes, all checked layers | Justice40/CEJST and EPA IRA Disadvantaged Communities. |

# Practical Meaning for EJAM v2.5.0

EJAM should allow Island Area blockgroups to appear in datasets, exports, and
maps where blockgroup-level data are available. EJAM should not imply that the
full ACS demographic indicator set, EJ Indexes, or block-based radius analysis
are available there.

For future work, Island Area block helper coverage could be revisited, but that
would require a separate build and validation of Island Area block points,
block weights, and block-to-blockgroup crosswalks.
